Lake Agro initiated its integrated sugarcane and sugar manufacturing project in Tanzania in 2021, associated with 16,000 hectares of land.

634 hectares of sugarcane have been planted using Centre Pivot, Semi-solid and Drip irrigation systems. The development is supported by 17 km of 33KV High Tension Power Line and further bulk-water infrastructure.

The current plant capacity is 2,500 TCD and is expandable to 3,500 TCD. Bosch Projects (Pty) Ltd of South Africa and Booker Tate Limited of the United Kingdom are the international consultants supporting the project.

records.text: Mr. Ally Edha Awadh is the Founder and Chairman of Lake Group. Born and raised in Tanzania, he completed his primary education locally before pursuing various jobs that shaped his work ethic and entrepreneurial mindset.

At the age of 23, he moved to Canada to pursue higher education. While there, he launched his first business in the clothing industry. The success of that venture helped him recognise his entrepreneurial potential and pursue larger opportunities.

At the age of 26, he acquired a licence from Tanzania’s Petroleum Bulk Procurement Agency (PBPA). This milestone laid the foundation for what became Lake Energies, which grew into the cornerstone of the diversified Lake Group.

Through his vision, perseverance and strategic leadership, Lake Group has grown into one of East Africa’s leading private-sector conglomerates. In 2022, he received the “Young Business Leader of the Year” recognition from African Leadership Magazine.

Under his leadership, the Group’s footprint spans 10 countries, with industrial operations contributing to employment and economic empowerment across the region. Beyond business, he is committed to community welfare initiatives and strategic partnerships contributing to sustainable development across East Africa.
“With a team of experienced engineers and business professionals across our units, Lake Group is fully geared to meet the demands of the global marketplace.”

Lake Group's leadership provides the expertise, strategic vision and commitment to excellence that support the Group's growth, diversification, innovation, operational excellence and sustainable value creation across every market we serve.
